definition: Stopped the continuous progress of an activity or person.
exampleSentence: The lecturer was speaking when a sudden alarm interrupted him.

definition: The setting or circumstances associated with an event.
exampleSentence: Soft instrumental music was playing in the cafe background.
The power outage occurred while technicians were testing the cables.

definition: Saw an event, typically a crime or accident, take place.
exampleSentence: Several pedestrians witnessed the accident while waiting at the crossing.
The bells were ringing while crowds were gathering outside.
